_comment: AD-21. The Compose Specification JSON Schema records no version information
at all: it is a single, current, unified document, which is exactly why the
file's own `version:` field must never be used to select one. This file is
the separate, explicitly partial record of the other half of AD-21 — where a
key's minimum Compose is KNOWN, it is written down here so the inspector can
mark keys newer than the reader's installed binary as unsupported-here rather
This is NOT the available-key list. That list is generated from
compose-spec.json at runtime and nothing here can add to it or remove from
it — a key absent from this file is offered with no mark at all, which is the
honest answer when the minimum is unknown. Being incomplete therefore costs a
missing annotation, never a hidden key.
Keys are matched by the last segment of the config path, so `develop` covers
`services.<name>.develop`. Scope is recorded for the reader, not used for
